# cato_dhcp_relay_group (Resource)

Manages one standalone DHCP relay group via networkConfig.dhcp. Unrelated collection items remain unchanged. Requires NCS_DHCP_PUBLIC_API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cato_dhcp_relay_group" "example" {
  name   = "Example relay group"
  server = ["192.0.2.53", "192.0.2.54"]
}
# ID is opaque. Existing site/range DHCP APIs can resolve the group by name;
# do not use this opaque ID where a legacy numeric entity ID is required.
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Relay group name, unique within account.
- `server` (List of String) DHCP relay server addresses.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier. Collection item IDs are opaque and must be preserved unchanged.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cato_dhcp_relay_group.example OPAQUE_RESOURCE_ID
```
